Elena (CEO): Quick Friday check — short update and three asks before next week
Elena (CEO): Highlights: EU private release window looks green but a few open legal/KMS items. We had a short incident on Tue (notes below) — overall reliability is back to normal.
Elena (CEO): Metrics snapshot: median gen latency ~45ms, 95th ~230ms (hosted), Dedicated throughput stable at target, infra cost vs. plan -1.8% (good).
Elena (CEO): Asks: 1) Mateo — finish the staged rollback doc + runbook; 2) Priya — confirm comms plan for partner customers; 3) Lisa/Ops — finalize pricing change cadence for reserved capacity.
Mateo (VP Eng): Ack — rollback doc in PR, staging playbook tested this morning. Putting runbook link in #eng-runtime.
Mateo (VP Eng): Also: we observed a KV-cache thrash when a canary started sending long-context bursts. Mitigated by fallback routing to smaller-quantized model-variant.
Omar (Head of Infra): Incident summary (Tue 02:14 UTC): brief spike in 95th latency to ~900ms for ~12min, error rate (5xx) +3%. Root cause: cache eviction policy + mis-sized batch window under canary traffic pattern. Remediated by reverting canary traffic and rolling out cache config fix.
Omar (Head of Infra): Action items: 1) tighten eviction thresholds for dynamic prefixes, 2) add alarm for sustained 95th >600ms, 3) schedule postmortem next Tue 10:00.
Priya (VP Product): For EU private rollouts: legal flagged two minor contract clauses (data retention term + subprocessor list). Working with legal; target to close EOD Monday. Planning a short partner note if we keep Wed rollout.
Lisa (Finance): Pricing cadence: want final reserved capacity tier by Tues so we can update docs and billing pipeline w/ next deploy.
Elena (CEO): Good. Mateo/Priya/Omar/Lisa — please comment in this thread when your items are done. If any blockers, drop a quick note here.
DeployBot: Deployment: canary-2024.11.17 started 02:05 UTC, automated rollback triggered 02:17 UTC (reason: latency threshold).
Mateo (VP Eng): FYI, adding an automated throttle to canaries for long-context traffic patterns — PR 4523. Will land today.
Priya (VP Product): Comms draft to partners ready for review. Pinged @Elena and @Lisa for signoff.
Elena (CEO): Thanks everyone — main priority next week is stable EU rollout and tightening our fallback paths so customer impact is zero if a canary misbehaves. Short weekly all-hands note on Monday with the outcomes. :rocket:
Omar (Head of Infra): Noted. I'll post the incident blameless timeline and the config diff in #incidents after the postmortem.
Lisa (Finance): I'll lock the pricing doc Tue morning and start the billing dry-run.
Elena (CEO): One more reminder: if you touch deploy/fallback code please add a quick unit test for cache behavior — small guard saves customers headaches.
Mateo (VP Eng): On it.
Priya (VP Product): Will update partner comms after legal signs off.
Elena (CEO): Closing: thanks team, enjoy the weekend if you're off. We reconvene Monday 09:00 for the rollout check-in. :coffee:
